competences.description: Summons crows to attack the enemy, inflicting Continuous Damage for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Covers all enemies with poison to remove one beneficial effect, inflicts damage and prevents them from receiving beneficial effects for 1 turn.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
All beneficial effects will be blocked

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times by summoning thorny bushes and inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 60% chance each. The last attack additionally puts them to sleep for 1 turn with a 60% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
